why_ai: Unlicensed screen-based design work where generative tools and Canva-style templates are absorbing the commodity end, protected mainly by client relationships and the director's eye.
why_clarity: Good design is judged by taste and settled by the creative director, though revision rounds and print proofs give fast, partial feedback.
why_digital: Briefs, assets and files in, digital files out to clients and printers, and studios are routinely hired remotely.

why_ai: Clients pay for a studio's judgement and rationale on a mark they will live with for years, which generic generators do not replace at this level.
why_clarity: Each identity is a one-off judged by taste, and whether it worked shows only a year later in how intact it remains.
why_digital: Research and design happen on screens and deliver files and guidelines, with in-person presentation for larger clients.

why_ai: Regulated copy, dielines and print behaviour add some protection, but artwork production is highly automatable.
why_clarity: Mixes taste-driven shelf design with exact, checkable artwork production.
why_digital: Design is digital, but dielines, substrates, physical comps and press checks tie the work to physical packs.

why_ai: Redesigns are high-stakes brand decisions bought on a studio's judgement, though attention prediction erodes some of it.
why_clarity: Shelf success is judged by taste in review and by sales months later, rarely joined back to the design.
why_digital: Designed on screen but judged in physical shelf context and sometimes physical mock-ups.

why_ai: Rule-bound copy propagation and verification that software increasingly does, with recall exposure keeping a human signing off.
why_clarity: The files match the copy deck and the rules or they don't, across thousands of near-identical SKU changes.
why_digital: Copy decks and artwork files in, press-ready files out to printers.

why_ai: Per-page typesetting and correction entry are routine and already offshored, and automated layout is improving fast.
why_clarity: House styles and proof stages define the deliverable, and corrections are checkable page by page.
why_digital: Manuscripts in, print and ebook files out, bought remotely including from offshore typesetters.

why_ai: Site surveys, building context and ADA accountability tie the work to physical places and coordination with architects.
why_clarity: ADA rules and schedules are codified, but wayfinding strategy and sign placement need site judgement.
why_digital: Starts from buildings and site visits, is drawn on screens, and ends in fabricated, installed signs.

why_ai: Direct clients hire a known person, but low-end freelance work is the first to be lost to generators and templates.
why_clarity: Each job is judged on taste through informal feedback rounds with no producer to define done.
why_digital: Everything is remote: briefs, feedback, files and payment, often across borders.

why_ai: Accuracy confirmed by an examiner or expert, with filing consequences, keeps a skilled human in the loop.
why_clarity: Rules like 37 CFR 1.84 and source CAD make accuracy checkable, though interpretation varies by subject.
why_digital: CAD files, specs and sometimes specimens in, digital figures out to remote clients.

why_ai: Re-laying out an approved master into formats is exactly what creative automation now does.
why_clarity: Format specs and brand rules define every variant, repeated dozens of times per launch.
why_digital: Master files in, digital and print-ready variants out.

why_ai: Logo generation is already automated and sold for tens of dollars.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical small-business requests, but quality is taste and ownability shows only at filing.
why_digital: Bought, generated and delivered entirely online.

why_ai: Normative databases carry trust with brands, but synthetic panels and attention prediction threaten routine pack tests.
why_clarity: Standard tests against category norms recur at volume, but are rarely validated against in-market sales.
why_digital: Panels and eye tracking, partly in physical facilities, delivered as digital reports.

why_ai: Analyst relevance judgement on conflicts persists, though image and text search increasingly screen automatically.
why_clarity: Search reports follow a standard format at volume, but whether a cleared mark is challenged shows only later.
why_digital: Register and web data searched and delivered as online reports to counsel worldwide.

why_ai: Valuations defended in transactions, tax and litigation rely on a named firm's judgement and standing.
why_clarity: ISO 10668 codifies the method, but assumptions vary and valuations are rarely tested against outcomes.
why_digital: Financial and survey data modelled on screens, with some in-person engagement.

why_ai: A testifying expert must personally design, defend and stand behind the survey in court.
why_clarity: Survey formats are established, but each case is bespoke and the court's verdict comes late.
why_digital: Online surveys and reports, with depositions and testimony in person.

why_ai: High-volume artwork and prepress production is rule-bound work that automation keeps absorbing.
why_clarity: Artwork either matches specifications and prints correctly or it doesn't, across millions of SKUs.
why_digital: Files in, but plates, cylinders and press support make part of the output physical.

why_ai: The standard's authority and forecasters' reputation carry trust that a generator lacks.
why_clarity: Forecasts are judgement calls checked loosely against later seasons.
why_digital: Physical colour guides and swatches sit alongside digital libraries and reports.

why_ai: Board-level rebrands are bought on senior strategists' judgement and relationships.
why_clarity: Every engagement is bespoke and its success is debated for years.
why_digital: Research and design on screens, sold and presented in person to boards.

why_ai: Examination decisions carry legal authority that a statute assigns to officials.
why_clarity: Examination follows written manuals across hundreds of thousands of near-identical applications.
why_digital: Electronic filings examined and decided online, within a national jurisdiction.

why_ai: Detecting font use and matching it to licences is automatable software work.
why_clarity: A font is licensed for a use or it isn't, checked across many near-identical cases.
why_digital: Websites, apps and files scanned and letters sent remotely.

why_ai: Trend reports from search behaviour are analysis AI produces readily, and generators erode the libraries.
why_clarity: Visual trends are interpretive and rarely checked against outcomes.
why_digital: Platform behaviour data analysed and published online.

why_ai: Product research inside software companies is screen work increasingly assisted by AI analytics.
why_clarity: Research informs product bets whose results show in adoption months later.
why_digital: Telemetry and user studies run online, delivered as software.

why_ai: Matching, pricing and fraud detection on transaction data are core automation targets.
why_clarity: Matching recurs millions of times with measurable completion and ratings.
why_digital: Entirely online platforms connecting remote buyers and designers.

why_ai: Member trust and advocacy roles persist, though surveys and pricing data are easy to replicate.
why_clarity: Surveys and pricing guides follow repeatable methods but are interpreted loosely.
why_digital: Surveys and publications produced and distributed online, with member events.

why_ai: Peer recognition from respected juries is the product, which AI cannot confer.
why_clarity: Judging is taste by rotating juries.
why_digital: Entries submitted online, with physical annuals and in-person ceremonies.

why_ai: Compiling rate data into a guide is routine analysis.
why_clarity: Rates and salaries are measurable figures recomputed annually.
why_digital: Placement data compiled and published online.

why_ai: Queue-based commodity design production is directly substituted by generative tools.
why_clarity: Requests are defined tasks repeated at volume with turnaround targets.
why_digital: Requests and files exchanged online with remote, often offshore designers.

why_ai: Licensed underwriters and claims handlers carry accountability, though small-business lines are increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Underwriting rules are codified, but claims outcomes arrive slowly.
why_digital: Policies quoted, bound and serviced online, largely through bundles.
